rows.en: We are an evil secret society whose goal is to modify the people of the whole world and control them as we please!
What kind of nonsense is that? More importantly, who are you!? Let me out of here!

I am the great Leader of Shocker… the new ruler of the entire world.

Right now, I am speaking to you over a secret line from Shocker Headquarters, far away from where you are.
The Leader of Shocker?
The man we seek has an IQ of 600 and excels at every sport. You are a young man chosen for glory.
Ridiculous…! I never agreed to join Shocker!

Heh heh heh… It's too late, Takeshi Hongo…

Regardless of your will, you have already all but become a member of Shocker.

A week has passed since you lost consciousness… In that time, Shocker's scientists have modified your body. You are now a cyborg!

Cyborgs will move the world, and I am the one who controls those cyborgs. The world will bend to my will!
A cyborg? Ha ha ha… As if I'd believe that!!
Heh heh heh… Then show him, so he has no choice but to believe!!

Yes, sir…

Injecting energy into Hongo's internal dynamo. You there, send in the wind!!
…Good, stop!

We will now run 50,000 volts through your body. An ordinary human would become a charred corpse in an instant.

But your modified body has stored up wind energy. Begin the discharge!!
Waaaaagh…

Not a single burn will remain on your body. The only reason you feel that pain is that your brain has not yet been modified.

Once the brain modification is done and you move only on command, you will become a perfect Shocker cyborg!!

…Good, stop the discharge!
Ngh… I-I'd die before I became the man you bastards want!

Everyone thinks that at first… and in time, they come to be grateful that they are members of Shocker!

…Begin Takeshi Hongo's brain modification!!
What's going on!?
An unidentified object, possibly a meteorite, has crashed! The impact knocked out the generator!

Damn it, at a time like this! We'll see to repairing the generator. …In any case, the operation is suspended!

Combatants, begin investigating that object at once!

What is this…!?

A capsule for atmospheric entry? It doesn't seem to have any nationality marked on it… Where in the world is it from…?
Wh-what the!?
Wh-who are you!?
Looks like… we made it down to Earth safely?

[HERO2]… In this case, "safely" may not be the appropriate word.

Also… these Earthlings are a little different from the image I had from what you told me, [HERO2].

You've got that right… What's more, it looks like we're not welcome!

[HERO4]! Analyze these guys' biological structure.
Roger.

Scan complete!

Their bodies show clear traces of enhancement modification… They appear to be cyborgs, but it doesn't seem to have been done with Vol cells.

In other words… cyborgs made without Vol?

Seems Earth has changed in these 15 years…

All right… Who did this, and where? I'm going to find out!

What are you jabbering about?

We won't forgive anyone who gets in Shocker's way! Get them!!
Damn it, if only I could get these chains off…
…I tore through iron chains? Me? Have I really been turned into a cyborg!?

…!?

Hey, Hongo's escaping! Send more combatants!
That's right… This is no time to grieve! Whatever happens, I have to get out of here…

Takeshi Hongo! It's useless to try to escape!

Now, come back to Shocker. Otherwise, I'll kill you! Hoah, hoah, hoah…

Shocker's pursuers…

Thanks to you bastards, I've ended up with power like a monster's…

But… I'll use this power to crush the schemes of you Shocker bastards!
Hoah, hoah, hoah… Takeshi Hongo! You mean to betray Shocker?

Modified by you bastards, I'm no longer the Takeshi Hongo I used to be.

I'm a warrior of justice who'll crush Shocker's schemes… Kamen Rider!!
[HERO2]… That appears to be a different type of cyborg.
Infighting among them? He doesn't seem like an ordinary human either.

He has probably undergone modification surgery too…

But… it seems he hasn't undergone the brain modification yet. He alone clearly has a sense of self.

A sense of self, huh…

So he's a cyborg… but he doesn't exist as a mere tool?

Yes…

Just as you awakened to your own self and got yourself back, [HERO2], he too is resisting with everything he has…

We can't just leave him, can we?

All right… We're helping him, [HERO4]!
Right!

…!?

Damn, reinforcements!

[HERO4]! Activate Roaring Steel! We'll take them all down at once!

Roger!

Transmitting equip position coordinates to the command satellite!

Setting: "Gravity Combat." Armament: "Close Combat." Roaring Steel, activate!!
Roaring Steel, equip!!

…!?

You transformed? Are you Shocker? Are you cyborgs too?
We'll talk later! For now, let's take care of these guys!

This is Gavan, advancing into the Solar System…

Near Jupiter, the Solar System's fifth planet, I've found the Galactic Union's S-class most wanted fugitive, Black Knight Lucifard!

Black Knight Lucifard?

Isn't he a top executive of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager, the space crime organization that manipulates all the evil in the universe from the shadows?

Gavan, will you be all right on your own?

Yeah… He's a vicious opponent, all right, but now that I've found him, I have to do this!

Marine, if anything happens to me… tell Commander Kom to dispatch the Space Sheriff assigned to the Earth sector as my successor!

Gavan…

All right! But be careful! Black Knight Lucifard is a dangerous man who wields the Roaring Steel…

Thanks, Marine…

But I'll be fine. I'll show him the power of the super-dimensional high-speed ship Dolgiran! Let's go, Electronic Starbeast Dol!!
The Galactic Union Police, founded with Planet Bird at its center to keep order and peace in the galaxy… dispatched officers wielding super-weapons to each star system.
One such officer, known as a Space Sheriff, has now come to our Solar System. His name is Gavan. Space Sheriff Gavan!
You won't get away! Galactic Union S-class most wanted fugitive, Black Knight Lucifard!!

Heh heh heh… A Space Sheriff, eh?

But… if you get in my way, you won't go home alive! Our Battle Fleet Nation Naager takes orders from no one!
What!? What in the world are you people of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager plotting?

Ha ha ha… I have no need to explain to the likes of you!

Our Battle Fleet Nation Naager, led by Steel Emperor Zephas, is the all-powerful, all-knowing creator!
Steel Emperor Zephas?

That's right…

Lord Zephas will give humanity warning, guide humanity, and make his will known to all creation!

Heh heh heh… This whole universe, and whether you live or die, lies entirely at Lord Zephas's will!
What!? I won't allow such arrogance! Not while I, Space Sheriff Gavan, am here!!

Ha ha ha, interesting… So you mean to defy us?

Fadita! Let's play with this man for a while!
Roger, Lucifard!

…!?

His partner Fadita is with him too!?

Ngh… Bring it on! Here I come, Lucifard!
Have at you, Space Sheriff Gavan!!
The battle between Lucifard and Gavan was fierce in the extreme… the struggle swung back and forth on and on.
But the tightly coordinated attacks of Lucifard and Fadita gradually began to push Gavan back… Even Dol, whom he relied on, began to show heavy damage.
Ngh, this is bad… At this rate, I'll be finished. I have to find some opening, any opening!

Space Sheriff…

Gavan, was it? To give me this much trouble… you're quite something…

But this is the end! Roaring Steel, maximum output!!
Roar!! Bullet of gravitons! Gravity Napalm!!

…!?

Ngh, Dol Laser!!
Uoooooh!!
What!?

Ugh, nngh…

…I'm alive? Did I win…? Where is he? Where's Lucifard…?

…He's gone?

But… I definitely felt that hit land.

Still, Dolgiran and I are both in tatters. I can't chase him any further. I'll have to head back to Planet Bird for now…
…Lucifard! Lucifard!
Ughhh…
Vital signs weak… Roaring Steel shifting to life-support mode.
